say:2:1130319002:1.text: It's lucky sandbeasts are so abundant in the desert. Allows for delicious meals to be the everyday standard.
say:2:1130319002:1.source_cn: 多亏了我们生活在野猪频出的沙漠，每天才能做出这些丰盛的料理。

say:3:1130319003:1.text: Of course, it's all thanks to the strength of our clan. No one else would be able to tackle such beasts.
